name: Chấm điểm lead bằng Custom Module Action
description: Mẫu cấu trúc: thay projectSlug, actionKey, input và hai schema bằng dữ liệu từ danh mục action của Workspace, sinh lại ID trước khi tạo; chưa kiểm thử trên Workspace.
xmlString:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn2:definitions xmlns:bpmn2="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI" xmlns:configEx="http://config-ex/schema" xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC" xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI" xmlns:elEx="http://element-ex/schema" id="cogover-diagram" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn2:process id="PECMAEXAMPLE01">
    <bpmn2:startEvent id="NOCMAEXAMPLE01" name="Bắt đầu">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <configEx:elementInfo renderKey="START_NORMAL_EVENT" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>FLCMAEXAMPLE01</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:startEvent>
    <bpmn2:sendTask id="NOCMAEXAMPLE02" name="Chấm điểm lead">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <elEx:customModuleActionTask />
        <configEx:elementInfo renderKey="CUSTOM_MODULE_ACTION_TASK" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>FLCMAEXAMPLE01</bpmn2:incoming>
      <bpmn2:outgoing>FLCMAEXAMPLE02</bpmn2:outgoing>
    </bpmn2:sendTask>
    <bpmn2:endEvent id="NOCMAEXAMPLE03" name="Kết thúc quy trình">
      <bpmn2:extensionElements>
        <configEx:elementInfo renderKey="END_EVENT" />
      </bpmn2:extensionElements>
      <bpmn2:incoming>FLCMAEXAMPLE02</bpmn2:incoming>
    </bpmn2:endEvent>
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="FLCMAEXAMPLE01" sourceRef="NOCMAEXAMPLE01" targetRef="NOCMAEXAMPLE02" />
    <bpmn2:sequenceFlow id="FLCMAEXAMPLE02" sourceRef="NOCMAEXAMPLE02" targetRef="NOCMAEXAMPLE03" />
  </bpmn2:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="BPMNDiagram_CMAEXAMPLE">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="BPMNPlane_CMAEXAMPLE" bpmnElement="PECMAEXAMPLE01">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NOCMAEXAMPLE01_di" bpmnElement="NOCMAEXAMPLE01">
        <dc:Bounds x="40" y="260" width="60" height="60" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="49" y="330" width="42" height="16" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NOCMAEXAMPLE02_di" bpmnElement="NOCMAEXAMPLE02">
        <dc:Bounds x="200" y="260" width="60" height="60" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="185" y="330" width="90" height="16" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="NOCMAEXAMPLE03_di" bpmnElement="NOCMAEXAMPLE03">
        <dc:Bounds x="360" y="260" width="60" height="60" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="336" y="330" width="108" height="16" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="FLCMAEXAMPLE01_di" bpmnElement="FLCMAEXAMPLE01">
        <di:waypoint x="100" y="290" />
        <di:waypoint x="200" y="290" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="FLCMAEXAMPLE02_di" bpmnElement="FLCMAEXAMPLE02">
        <di:waypoint x="260" y="290" />
        <di:waypoint x="360" y="290" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn2:definitions>
